identity.baseline: monaco-editor@0.56.0 official npm package plus monaco-editor-core@0.56.0 final source

authorities.clockContract: E1-R wall-clock milliseconds and injected traces own Date.now behavior.

publicSurface.rawCoordinates: All line, column and inner-change ranges use Monaco's one-based line/column and raw-UTF16 column domain fixed by M1/F1.
publicSurface.identityRule: The worker's identical field compares line count and each line's raw UTF-16 content; it does not compare an EOL byte sequence separately.

algorithmDisposition.native: Repository-owned Swift port of the complete pinned LegacyLinesDiffComputer source graph.
Repository-owned Swift port of the complete pinned DefaultLinesDiffComputer, DynamicProgramming, Myers, move detection and heuristic source graph.
Accept the value, mark the diff stale, emit one sanitized internal MonaDiffAlgorithmUnavailable event for each attempted computation, publish no new result and fire no diff-update event.
algorithmDisposition.fallback: Never fall back to advanced or legacy; no @vscode/diff implementation ships.

algorithmDisposition.native: Accept the value, mark the diff stale, emit one sanitized internal MonaDiffAlgorithmUnavailable event for each attempted computation, publish no new result and fire no diff-update event.
algorithmDisposition.fallback: Never fall back to advanced or legacy; no @vscode/diff implementation or WASM ships.

externalAlgorithmEvidence.source: Both external values dynamically resolve @vscode/diff/dist/index.js; the official monaco-editor@0.56.0 package declares no @vscode/diff dependency.

fixedChromeProbe.unhandledRejection: Cannot determine URI for module id!
Cannot determine URI for module id!

externalAlgorithmEvidence.stateAfterFailure: A fresh editor retains undefined diff state. An editor with a prior result retains that prior result, sets isDiffUpToDate false, and publishes no replacement until a later functional computation succeeds.
externalAlgorithmEvidence.scope: This disposition matches the fixed official npm standalone baseline. A consumer-supplied @vscode/diff module or custom AMD resolution is outside G4 and does not add a native plugin point.

maxComputationTime.clock: Signed Unix-epoch integer wall milliseconds through E1.

maxFileSize.contract: Preserve default, validation, raw option value and option-change observations. It imposes no diff computation size limit and never rejects or truncates a model.

optionSemantics.ignoreTrimWhitespace: Default true. Legacy and advanced receive the exact value. The unavailable external algorithms publish no result.
optionSemantics.computeMoves: Derived from experimental.showMoves, default false. Advanced and legacy preserve their source behavior; the external values publish no result.
optionSemantics.extendToSubwords: Retain the exact advanced character-refinement option flow from the pinned worker inputs and source graph.
optionSemantics.validation: Invalid strings select the default, aliases map before computation, integer options use the pinned clampedInt semantics and updateOptions preserves source event ordering.

advancedSemantics.timeout: Construct one DateTimeout at computation start when maxComputationTimeMs is nonzero. Every line, character, heuristic and move phase shares that object. isValid remains true only while Date.now minus startTime is strictly less than the timeout and becomes sticky false after first expiration.
advancedSemantics.lineAlgorithmSwitch: When original line count plus modified line count is strictly less than 1700, use the pinned improved dynamic-programming algorithm; otherwise use the pinned Myers algorithm.
advancedSemantics.characterAlgorithmSwitch: For each refined slice, when original raw-UTF16 length plus modified raw-UTF16 length is strictly less than 500, use dynamic programming; otherwise use Myers.
advancedSemantics.lineHashing: Build perfect integer identities from each line's trim() result while retaining original raw lines for equality scoring and character refinement.
phases: whitespace-change scan when ignoreTrimWhitespace is false
optional move detection and move refinement
advancedSemantics.timeoutResult: A source check that observes expiration preserves the source-produced approximation, sets hitTimeout, and maps to quitEarly true. No extra check is inserted inside a source-atomic expensive step.
advancedSemantics.emptyFastPaths: Identical single empty lines return no changes. When either side is the single empty line, return the pinned whole-document mapping without running the general algorithms.

legacySemantics.implementation: Port the complete pinned line sequence, LCS/diff, pretty-diff, whitespace and character-change algorithm without substituting the advanced engine.
legacySemantics.lineTimeout: One predicate captures Date.now at DiffComputer construction and uses the full maxComputationTime; zero is infinite.
legacySemantics.characterTimeout: A separate predicate captures Date.now at construction and uses zero for infinite or min(maxComputationTime, 5000) otherwise.
legacySemantics.timeoutComparison: Both predicates continue only while Date.now minus their own start is strictly less than their limit.
legacySemantics.emptyFastPaths: Preserve the legacy empty-original and empty-modified mappings and char-change presence exactly.

providerAndViewModel.nativeExecution: Capture immutable original/modified snapshots and option values on MainActor, compute legacy/advanced in a Sendable off-main task, then return to MainActor for normalization, accumulated-edit application and publication.
providerAndViewModel.serialization: Each diff editor has one serial computation lane. Different diff editors can compute concurrently; one editor never has two algorithm bodies running concurrently or publishing out of source order.
providerAndViewModel.initialCompute: Model assignment starts one computation immediately.
providerAndViewModel.contentChange: If the last result can be transformed by the raw model edits, update its mapped state synchronously, set isDiffUpToDate false and debounce the next full computation by exactly 200 ms.
providerAndViewModel.changesDuringCompute: Record original and modified TextEditInfo while an algorithm runs, normalize its result, apply those accumulated edits in source order, then publish only after model/editor/generation validity succeeds.
providerAndViewModel.cancellation: The algorithm body is not semantically shortened by the public cancellation token. After computation, cancellation returns no changes, identical false, quitEarly true and no moves; disposal or invalid generation prevents publication and caching.
providerAndViewModel.disposedInput: Inputs already disposed at provider entry return no changes, identical true, quitEarly false and no moves.
providerAndViewModel.publication: A successful valid result atomically updates unchanged regions, last diff, diff state, moved-text selection and isDiffUpToDate, then emits the existing diff-update observation.

cacheContract.key: JSON array of original URI string and modified URI string
cacheContract.context: JSON array of original model ID, modified model ID, original alternativeVersionId, modified alternativeVersionId and JSON-serialized computation options
cacheContract.hit: Return the cached immutable result only when key and context are exactly equal.
cacheContract.eviction: Before inserting a computed result, if current Map size is greater than 10, remove the first insertion-order key; then set the current key.
cacheContract.correction: The source comment says max 10, but the pre-insert greater-than check permits 11 entries. D1-R fixes the observable high-water bound at 11.
cacheContract.invalidation: No explicit model/editor-disposal invalidation exists. Version/context mismatch prevents stale reuse; FIFO and process termination remove entries.
cacheContract.memoryPressure: H2 may evict this recomputable cache early without changing semantic state; ordinary execution must preserve the source FIFO rule and counters.
cacheContract.manifest: MonaCacheManifest.json must contain this exact stable ID, owner, key/context fields, maximum 11, eviction counter, hit/miss counter and retained-byte counter.

performanceAndComplexity.performanceGate: P10 retains 1/10/50 MiU16, 1/10/30 percent changes, legacy/advanced and multi-diff 1/10/100 item cells against both M0 and M1. Every latency, CPU and peak-footprint ratio gate remains at paired one-sided 95 percent upper bound <= 1.00.
performanceAndComplexity.complexity: Operation counters separately record line comparisons, DP cells, Myers frontier steps, character units, heuristic visits, move candidates, cache bytes and publication mappings; the native upper bound cannot exceed the pinned algorithm's bound for the same branch and input.
performanceAndComplexity.maxFileSizeRule: P10 includes inputs above the option's default 50 label to prove maxFileSize does not gate computation.
performanceAndComplexity.timeoutFixtures: Injected E1 wall-clock traces exercise T-1, T and T+1 at every source timeout check boundary for both engines, including backwards and forwards clock jumps.

dependencyAndCutBoundary.production: No @vscode/diff package, WASM, WebWorker, JavaScript engine or third-party runtime ships. Legacy and advanced are native Swift source ports.
dependencyAndCutBoundary.webWorker: The public WebWorker API remains cut by F1/S1; its removal does not cut legacy or advanced diff computation.
dependencyAndCutBoundary.externalImplementation: The @vscode/diff JavaScript and WASM algorithms are explicit implementation cuts while their four-value public option type and fixed-baseline unavailable behavior remain observable.

acceptance.C02: All RegExp or Unicode-sensitive subword/word behavior routes through M1/E1 and preserves raw UTF-16.
acceptance.C04: The four public diffAlgorithm values, aliases, option members and result mappings exist with their D1 dispositions; no external plugin API is added.
acceptance.C05: Legacy and advanced mappings, inner changes, moves, identical, quitEarly, options, empty/disposed/canceled states, 200 ms scheduling, accumulated edits, unavailable external behavior and events match the fixed baseline.
acceptance.C09: The linked cache registry and MonaCacheManifest contain the exact process FIFO cache with maximum 11; lifecycle, cancellation, memory-pressure and 24-hour soak gates pass.
acceptance.C10: Distribution scans prove native legacy/advanced source provenance and absence of @vscode/diff, WASM, WebWorker and JavaScript engine code or resources.
acceptance.P10: Every preregistered diff/multi-diff cell passes both-baseline gates; additional timeout, cache-hit/miss, maxFileSize-no-op and external-unavailable cases do not create a new workload ID.
